fact: In the third quarter of 2025 three e-money issuers (Lumicash, Ecocash, Cashtel) operated in Burundi, with about 101.6 million mobile-account transactions worth over 4,736 billion BIF, and the national switch handled mobile transactions and is described as ensuring interoperability between all payment systems.
title: Note trimestrielle sur la performance des systèmes et moyens de paiement, troisième trimestre 2025
publisher: Banque de la République du Burundi
